description: KL-07 is the primary Regional Transport Office for the Ernakulam district, headquartered in Kochi (Kakkanad). It serves as a major hub for vehicle registration and licensing in Kerala's commercial capital and was the first RTO in the state to reach the milestone of one million vehicle registrations.
address: 2nd Floor, Civil Station, Thrikkakara P.O., Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala
